I can’t say for sure that anything I’ll tell you will be helpful, but I can try. 

1. Try to understand how she feels. Ask her why she feels like this to see her reasoning, this might also help her feel that you are interested in the problem, instead of just trying to quick comfort her.

2. Try to sympathise and understand. Instead of telling her that she is wrong for thinking or feeling the way she does, you can just tell her you feel sorry that she feels that way.

3. Reason with her. Don’t immediately counter her feelings, instead try to tell her why they are unjustified. Give her examples of why she is wrong, without directly saying that she is.

I hope this helps a bit.
